parsed.note: The battery supplied emergency loads continuously for about 60 minutes, supported by the mobile dashboard's 62-minute runtime estimate and an email calling the trial a success (S3). The diesel generator was disconnected during the trial, contradicting claim B (S1). The trial started Thursday at 08:00, supported by the trial sign-in record (S2). Thus, the backup trial can be reported as complete based on battery performance without generator involvement.
